rows.resolution_note: Rule C: sentence 2 of p001 defines the authors' own proteomic analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data by a measurement and a procedure (2,920 plasma proteins measured, protein-disorder associations), beyond a number of participants; 52,615 equals no dictionary row's N and no release identifier or citation is given.
rows.quote: Using 2,920 plasma proteins measured in 52,615 UK Biobank participants, we identified 830 protein-disorder associations involving 574 proteins.
